issue_context.title: pytest tests/models fail
issue_context.body:
Running the following command on an H100 computer

```
pytest tests/models/
```

gave me the following errors:

```
FAILED tests/models/test_models.py::test_models[128-half-mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1] - AssertionError: tensor model parallel group is already initialized
FAILED tests/models/test_models.py::test_models[128-half-tiiuae/falcon-7b] - AssertionError: tensor model parallel group is already initialized
```

comments:
Other errors include 
1. complaining that eniops is not installed.
2. test_mistral.py complains that the Mistral model requires Half but got BFloat16
Yes, `--forked` works. Thank you @WoosukKwon . I am closing this PR.

review_comments: Mistral model uses bfloat16 as specified [here](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1/blob/9ab9e76e2b09f9f29ea2d56aa5bd139e4445c59e/config.json#L20).

Yes. Thanks.

I don't know why I had to change it to `half` this afternoon. But after git pull upstream, it seem bffloat16 works now.
